newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hugo Boss says aquires Swiss Della Croce.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Boss says aquires Swiss Della Croce.

text.p: German clothes manufacturer Hugo Boss said on Friday it had acquired the Swiss Della Croce Group with effect from September 30.

Della Croce, which had been a licensing parterre of Hugo Boss since 1983 and had been responsible for the production of Boss shirts for international markets, made profits of 40.3 million Swiss francs ($31.8 million) in 1995.

In a compulsory announcement, Hugo Boss said it intended to strengthen its international shirt business through the acquisition and added that it would also gain additional shirt production knowledge.
Hugo Boss did not say how much it had paid for the group.
Magnus Been, the previous Della Croce owner, would continue to direct the business, Hugo Boss said.
